issue_context.title: report warning when the hints are not followed by the certain keyword
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
Now, the hint can only take effect when it following the certain keyword, like `select`, `insert`, etc. When we write the hint in the wrong position, it will treat the hint like the comment and do nothing. So, we need report warning when we use the hint format but not write it in the right place.

review_comments: Can this warning take effect in `insert into  ... select /*+ hint()*/ ...` and subquery
